FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Upholstery Craft Co., we specialize in high-quality upholstery services for both residential and commercial clients. Our operations primarily involve the repair, restoration, and reupholstering of furniture, ensuring the use of industry-standard materials and techniques. Our skilled team is experienced in various upholstery methods, allowing us to deliver exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail. 

We maintain a commitment to safety and compliance, regularly auditing our processes to adhere to industry standards. Our inventory is carefully managed with appropriate security measures to prevent theft or damage. Additionally, we emphasize customer feedback to continuously improve our service quality. We also offer mobile upholstery services, backed by comprehensive commercial auto insurance, ensuring our team is fully equipped and covered while providing onsite solutions. Overall, we strive to provide reliable, environmentally friendly upholstery services that exceed our clients' expectations while minimizing operational risks.
